:::{#sol-dim-subadditive-practice}

Here $\mathcal{S}_1 \cap \mathcal{S}_2 = \cb{\vzero}$,
so @cor-dim-subadditive holds with equality:

$$
\dim(\mathcal{S}_1 + \mathcal{S}_2) = 2 + 3 = 5.
$$

Since $\mathcal{S}_1 + \mathcal{S}_2 \subseteq \reals^5$
and both have [dimension](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-dimension) $5$,
[the two are equal](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#thm-subspace-equal-dim):
$\mathcal{S}_1 + \mathcal{S}_2 = \reals^5$.

:::
